name: Saltline
headline: A rain-soaked container-port FPS that Claude Fable 5.2 built in about eight hours, every model and sound included.
prompts: You know, you should also build me a FPS. Insanely detailed quality pls, something that looks visually like it can keep up with AAA. Make it small in scope (like a tiny level) but …
prompt_note: the opening of the prompt, from the maker's reply

name: What the Water Keeps
headline: A slow, lantern-lit boat ride through eight dreamlike worlds, made with Claude Fable 5.2 and Three.js.

name: Oil Paint
headline: Walk through an autumn forest that looks hand-painted: about 1.5 million brush strokes a frame, at 200 fps in a browser tab.

name: Starry Night Rider
headline: Ride a bicycle through the village of Van Gogh's The Starry Night, every street painted in swirling brushstrokes.

name: Age of Dragon
headline: A huge open-world 3D fantasy RPG on a 12 × 12 km island, which its maker puts at about twice Skyrim's map: fly a dragon, ride horses and clear nine dungeons. He says he can't code and built it in a few days with Fable 5.2 and Opus 5.5; a free playable version is promised soon.

name: Mirror Earth
headline: The whole planet in voxels, in your browser: go anywhere, break anything, with weather that matches the real Earth live.

name: Mist-Locked Gate (雾锁山门)
headline: A wuxia action game in a snowy, lantern-lit mountain shrine, built by Claude Fable 5.2 in one afternoon as a single HTML file.

name: I Would Have Gotten Away With It
headline: A reverse Scooby-Doo: you are the villain of Grimsby Manor, and your job is to scare off the meddling kids and their capybara.

name: Gilt & Gutter
headline: A stylish 1v1 first-person shooter in a gilded arcade hall, where shots of your own colour charge your gun.

name: The Waking River
headline: Sail a golden boat through five sleeping worlds that wake as you pass, in a browser fantasy game made by Claude Fable 5.2.
prompt_note: the maker shared the full prompt as a PDF

name: Tidewright
headline: Sail a storm-tossed night sea and relight the lighthouses of the Thrumming Isles, built by Claude Fable 5.2.

name: Saltfire
headline: Armed offshore powerboat racing: race five AI rivals across five-metre seas with homing rockets and gun turrets, past sea stacks, oil rigs and wind farms. Higgsfield built it with Claude Fable 5.2 and three.js.

name: Parallax
headline: An arena FPS where everyone carries a portal door: open one behind an enemy, shoot through it, or use it to board their platform, on white marble arenas under a ringed planet. Anthropic's Sholto Douglas made it with Claude Fable 5.2 and playtests it against colleagues at the office. No public build.

name: Dragon Rider
headline: A dragon riding sim made with early access to Claude Fable 5.2: leap off floating sky islands above a sea of clouds, dive, and breathe fire on the villages below. The maker says the jump off the island feels like a roller coaster in the stomach, and also ported it to Roblox. No public build yet.

name: Starfall (星陨战纪)
headline: A free 5v5 MOBA in the style of Honor of Kings, with heroes from Chinese history, that Cheetah Mobile CEO Fu Sheng built overnight with Claude Fable 5.2. You plus nine AI players, on a computer or a phone.

name: Reef Dive
headline: One tank of air, one speargun and a 140 m sinkhole: spear fish, fight off sharks, pilot a research sub and recover lost relics on a living 3D reef. Upgraded with Claude Fable 5.2.

name: CORDON 9
headline: An endless first-person zombie shooter on a rain-soaked quarantine street, with a scoped rifle and a killstreak drone, and not a single asset file: Perplexity CEO Aravind Srinivas had an agent build it with Claude Fable 5.2.

name: Great Wave
headline: Surf Hokusai's Great Wave off Kanagawa: the woodblock print becomes a game where you row a little boat through the barrel, past the gods of wind and thunder, toward Mount Fuji. Made with Claude Fable 5.2.

name: Skywake: Kite & Mo's Big Flight
headline: A storybook flying adventure: ride Mo, a big gliding sky creature, over a turquoise lagoon of rock spires, sing to giant masked Tallwalkers and dodge the lamps that throw nets. Made with Gemini 4 Argon, then refreshed with Claude Opus 5.5.

name: Valley Ride
headline: A calm horse ride across a mountain valley to a campfire at sunset, in three.js and WebGPU. Built in two days with Claude Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.2, and open source.

name: NightClub: Drift & Speed
headline: Drift through a rainy neon city at night, chain drift and speed zones for score, and race the maker's ghost on a worldwide leaderboard. Made in 72 hours with Claude Fable 5.2, Blender, three.js and Higgsfield.

name: Danfo Run
headline: Drive a yellow danfo through Lagos traffic, load passengers and top the live leaderboard. The browser game that went viral in Nigeria as Lagos Run.

name: The Clockmaker's Heart
headline: Wake a sleeping clockwork giant one gear puzzle at a time, a first draft by Claude Fable 5.2.

name: Aestra: The Last Wish
headline: A permadeath pixel-art action RPG you play online with others: 9 classes, 100 levels, 3 raids and one life. Its maker quit his job, can't code, and built it with Opus 5.5 on the AI game maker Tesana; over 27,000 players so far.

name: Cayley
headline: A browser flight simulator with real wing physics, 9 real aircraft and the whole planet streamed in 3D, built overnight by Claude Fable 5.2.

name: MAAD MAXXING
headline: A Mad Max-style desert car-combat game in three.js and WebGPU, written by Claude Fable 5.2 in 100% code with no models or textures.

name: Turbo Tails
headline: A 3D kart racer with six animal drivers, drifting and items, playable free in the browser with friends.
prompts: Ok let's add multiplayer the simplest way
prompt_note: two of the three prompts, from the maker's replies

name: Party Royale
headline: A Fall Guys-style party royale with dozens of jelly-bean players, fake doors and slime floors, made in one try.

name: Fablecraft
headline: An infinite voxel sandbox with HDR lighting in a single HTML file, made in two prompts.
prompts: eh looks basic, make it hdr
prompt_note: both prompts, run on extra-high effort

name: Lumenvale
headline: A gentle open-world fantasy: wake the seven sleeping shrines of a flower valley. Claude Fable 5.2 made the game, its music and its trailer.

name: Rifts
headline: An Overwatch-style 3v3 hero brawler with 12 heroes, world-hopping rifts and boss fights, free in the browser.

name: Memory of Teresa: The Storm Spire
headline: A dark gothic boss fight on a storm-lashed cathedral spire, lightning against blade, one-shotted with Claude Fable 5.2.

name: Street Brawler II
headline: A pixel-art arcade fighter with eight original fighters and eight stages, one-shotted by Claude Fable 5.2 in 35 minutes.

name: Toy Room Adventure
headline: Shrink down to toy size and explore a sunlit kids' bedroom, built by Claude Fable 5.2 from one shared prompt.
prompts: I want you to create a three.js third-person game where I am Woody from Toy Story inside the house, and I can walk and jump through furniture and objects and find the other characters. Make sure to capture the aesthetic and style of the movie.

name: Tokyo Night GP
headline: Race five rivals through neon Tokyo at night on wet, reflective asphalt: one prompt, 30 minutes, three.js.

name: Samurai Duel
headline: Two samurai, one red moon: a one-prompt sword-fighting game from Claude Fable 5.2 on High.

name: Aiden's Revenge
headline: A 1–4 player pixel-art beat 'em up dreamed up and drawn by a kid named Aiden, finished overnight with Claude Fable 5.2.

name: Brasidas
headline: A Halo-style 10v10 team shooter on a ring world: storm a tropical beach or fight across a marble sanctum above the clouds. Made in a few prompts on the AI game maker Tesana by Mike Houser, who also made Aestra.

name: Geminisland
headline: Google's launch demo for Gemini 4 Hydrogen: a shared voxel island where one prompt, like "huge banana statue", becomes a building in seconds, then you walk the streets and step inside in first person. Opens in Google AI Studio (Google sign-in needed).

name: PaletteRider
headline: Ride a bicycle inside famous paintings, from Paul Klee's Castle and Sun to Van Gogh's Café Terrace at Night, collecting little suns before dawn. Built with Claude Fable 5.2, from the 3D cities to the music.

name: Handful: Island God Game
headline: A 3D god game on an island of 8 million simulated voxels: with one giant hand and powers like parting the sea, rain and wind, lead a dozen little cube villagers to the light. Made with Claude Fable 5.2.

name: BODY-CAM
headline: A realistic body-camera police shooter: serve a warrant at 1147 Elm St. and clear a run-down house room by room with your squad, now with 5v5 multiplayer. Made by a creator called Juicer on the AI game maker Tesana; its most-played game this week.

name: GO AGAIN
headline: A third-person squad shooter against waves of giant alien spiders: clear the breach, bring down the Hive Anchor, reach the dropship, and if you die, go again with upgrades. Built on Crayon with Claude Fable 5.2 in under two hours.

name: Patchwork Quilt
headline: Walk a little rag doll across a stop-motion world sewn from a patchwork quilt, with felt cottages, a fabric windmill and a ribbon river. Made with Claude Fable 5.2, and the whole map is code.

name: Skyseed: Pip's Tempest Run
headline: A cute one-level 3D platformer from one prompt to Gemini 4 Hydrogen: guide Pip the sky-cat across three floating islands and grab all 12 sun-seeds before the storm hits in 90 seconds.

name: Painted Valley
headline: Run through a Ghibli-inspired painted valley of wind-swept grass, distant villages and huge clouds, as the light turns from midday blue to evening lilac. Made with Claude Fable 5.2.

name: Watercolour
headline: Walk a girl in a red hood through a pencil sketch that turns into watercolour wherever she goes: poppy meadows, a river, willows and a pink blossom tree bloom in as you walk.

name: Hogwarts Royale
headline: A wizard-school battle royale on brooms, from a single prompt: "create a mashup of Harry Potter and Fortnite".
prompts: Fable 5.2, create a mashup of Harry Potter and Fortnite

name: The Clockmaker's Mansion
headline: A Roblox horror game where a clock-faced owner hunts you through his mansion, built and trailered by Claude Fable 5.2 over MCP.

name: Neon Coast
headline: Fast cars, hot nights, bad ideas: a GTA-style driving game in a pink-lit Miami beach city, from a single prompt.

name: The Lost Storm
headline: An isometric dark-fantasy action RPG in the browser, in open alpha: wake in the mist, fight through rain-slick ruins and collect loot with legendary powers. Built in three.js with Claude Fable 5.2 and streamed live.
